newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TEXT OF ROMANIA FOREIGN INVESTMENT DECREE (6 of 7).
newsitem.headline: TEXT OF ROMANIA FOREIGN INVESTMENT DECREE (6 of 7).

text.p: (This is an unofficial translation of Romania's government Decree no.31/16.06.1997 on foreign investment. The unofficial translation was provided by Price Waterhouse Romania.
For any querries please contact Price Waterhouse at telephone +40-1 311-2455, fax +40-1 312-3334.)

Art. 20 (1) The right to benefit from the incentives set forth under Article 6, Article 7, paragraph (2) and article 8, paragraph (1) herein shall be proven by the Foreign Investor Certificate issued by the Romanian Development Agency.

(2) The right to benefit from the incentives granted under Article 10 herein is proven by the Foreign Investor Certificate issued by the Romanian Development Agency, based upon the share sale and purchase contract made with the State Ownership Fund, and by the bank statement proving that the payment was made.
(3) The Foreign Investor Certificate issued by the Romanian Development Agency shall be opposable to the Romanian customs and fiscal authorities.

(4) The issuance of the Investor Certificate, which proves the right of enjoying the incentives granted is made against a payment of a fee determined by Government resolution, upon the joint proposal of the Ministry of Finance and the Romanian Development Agency, which shall not exceed the lei equivalent of the amount of USD 25, calculated at the reference exchange rate of the National Bank of Romania in effect on payment date.

(5) The Romanian Development Agency shall withdraw the Foreign Investor Certificate granted initially if it finds out that, due to the fault of the foreign investor concerned, the criteria and conditions which initially justified the issuance thereof are no longer observed, in which case other types of incentives may be granted, subject to the satisfaction of the criteria and conditions required to this effect.

(6) The difference between the value of the incentives granted initially and the value of the incentives granted in accordance with the previous paragraph shall be borne by defaulting foreign investor, and shall be made income to the State Budget, by care of the Ministry of Finance.

(7) The companies incorporated as Romanian legal persons with foreign capital contribution shall report annually to the Romanian Development Agency within a maximum of 90 days from the end of the fiscal year to which the reports refers, the data required in order to prove the fulfillment by the foreign investor of its assumed obligations.

Art.21 (1) In the case that the foreign investments are liquidated in a period shorter than twice the length of the period for which the foreign investors benefited from any of the incentives provided herein, such foreign investors shall pay the taxes and duties provided by the law for the entire periodduring which the investment was operational.

(2) The taxes and duties due to the State according to the preceding paragraph shall be paid with priority from the liquidation proceeds of the investment or from other rightn to which foreign investors are entitled.

(3) The provisions of the paragraphs (1) and (2) shall also be applicable in the case that the value of the foreign investment made in the form of a company incorporated as a Romanian legal entity decreases below the limits stipulated by article 7, paragraph (1) and Article 8, Paragraph (1) herein.
